topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Got your surprise, huh? That’s just the sweetest thing. I can picture your face, all lit up and a bit startled, unwrapping it. I bet it’s a reminder of why you do what you do. These little moments, they’re the best, aren’t they? Making you realize the ripple you sent out reached someone and they wanted to send a thank you back. That’s what it’s all about, the impact we don’t always see. I hope it sits somewhere special and every now and then, it makes you smile for the same reason.
